summary: Verified both deployment-health-check fixes. (A) frontend/.env line 5 is now quoted: METRO_CACHE_ROOT="/app/frontend/.metro-cache" and Metro bundles cleanly (localhost:3000 HTTP 200, expo.out.log shows env var exported and bundler ready). (B) /governance/execution/[id] route resolves for both real and nonexistent IDs — no 404. Seeded a PROPOSED execution for high-risk 'Documentation Steward' agent; tapping the pending row on /governance navigates to /governance/execution/<id> and renders the ExecutionDetail screen (data-testid='execution-screen') with action, agent name, capability, PROPOSED state pill, state history, and the 'Approve & seal execution' button (data-testid='approve-execution'). Fallback path (nonexistent id) renders 'Execution not found or no longer pending' rather than a 404. Regression sweep: all 14 pre-existing top-level routes ((tabs)/console, timeline, graph, health, genome; /governance, /governance/submit, /governance/agent/<id>, /ledger, /settings, /note/new, /chat, /auth/login, /auth/register, /auth/welcome) resolve without 'Unmatched Route' / 404. No new 404s introduced.
action_items: Optional cleanup: one TEST_pending_exec (id 847b758e-584e-47d7-9eeb-00881a5ad9ba) seeded on demo user under 'Documentation Steward' remains in PROPOSED state; can be approved or reversed from /governance if you want a clean demo state.
critical_code_review_comments: ExecutionDetail fetches pending list then falls back to /api/executions (best-effort try/catch swallows errors). Works, but a dedicated GET /api/executions/{id} endpoint would be cleaner and avoid the double round-trip for the common case.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 1 PROPOSED execution (id=847b758e-584e-47d7-9eeb-00881a5ad9ba, agent='Documentation Steward', capability=memory.read, action='TEST_pending_exec') on demo@pocketos.app to exercise the full tap→detail flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both narrow fixes verified end-to-end. If future work touches env parsing or Expo Router route tree, re-run: (1) curl -sI http://localhost:3000 == 200, (2) navigate to /governance/execution/anything and confirm the ExecutionDetail component renders (not 404).
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — verification of prior fixes, no bugs found.
